title: Copywriting
summary: Writes and rewrites marketing copy for pages such as home, landing and pricing, with supportable claims.
benefit: Marketing pages get clear headlines and copy with claims you can back up.
solves: Marketing pages full of vague claims that any competitor could have written.
use_cases: "Write the homepage copy", or a landing, pricing or feature page: headline, subhead, CTA and each section.
"Improve this headline": only the changed lines come back, each with a one-line reason.
Headlines and CTAs come with 2-3 options and the reason for each.
A claim you cannot back up is not written: Claude says what proof would allow it.
Every line passes a test: could a competitor write this exact sentence? If yes, it is rewritten.
details: When you ask for marketing copy for a home, landing, pricing or feature page, Claude reads any product marketing notes first and writes or rewrites the copy, keeping every claim supportable; it stays out of docs and app UI labels. It is for you when you write or revise marketing pages or pick a headline. It copies a skill folder that loads only when used, with instructions only and no code running on its own.
risk: Instructions only; loads when used. No code runs on its own.
